name: qlrisk_catalog
title: qlrisk catalog
description: Discover what qlrisk can do before calling another tool. topic='products' lists every product (name, category, required fields, terms); add name='InterestRateSwap' for its full trade schema. topic='calculators' lists the credit, exposure, XVA, margin and SA-CCR calculators with their input fields and configuration (name='cva' for one). Other topics: 'stress_scenarios' (the historical crisis library), 'report_measures' (qlrisk_risk_report measures), 'processes' (Monte Carlo processes and parameters), 'market_data' (the sample snapshot and every risk-factor key, e.g. 'EQ.SPX', 'IR.FWD.SOFR.5Y'), 'enumerations' (currencies, indices, frequencies, risk classes ...), 'version' (qlrisk version and work bounds). Example: {"topic": "products", "category": "fx"}.
